views.rationale: AMZN's net sales increased 11% in 2024, compared to the prior year, while BAC's revenue increased $2.3 billion to $21.8 billion, primarily due to higher sales and trading revenue.

BA's BGS revenues in 2024 increased by $827 million compared with 2023, primarily due to higher commercial services revenue, while CAT's total sales and revenues decreased 3% in 2024, primarily driven by lower sales volume.

GOOGL's revenue growth rate could decline over time, but GS's net revenues in FICC intermediation were slightly higher, driven by significantly higher net revenues in currencies, mortgages and credit products.
JNJ's sales increase of 4.3% in 2024 was driven by a 5.9% volume increase, while KO's net operating revenues grew 2% in 2024, with volume contributing 1% to the increase.
JPM's net interest income increased 4% in 2024, while LIN's sales were flat in 2024 versus 2023, with a 2% increase from higher price attainment.
MSFT's 15% operating income growth outpaces NEE's 17% gross margin expansion.
NVDA's 62.4% operating income margin exceeds PFE's 54.1% margin.
PG's 3% organic sales growth outpaces UNH's 2% organic volume increase.
